name: What is the typical timeline for a mold cleanup project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a mold cleanup project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a mold cleanup project varies depending on the extent and location of the mold growth. A small, localized mold issue might be addressed in 1-3 days, including drying time. However, more extensive mold contamination involving hidden areas, structural damage, or large sections of a property can take anywhere from 3-7 days or even longer. This includes initial assessment, containment, removal, drying, and final cleaning. We will provide a detailed timeline after our initial inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small mold issues can take 1-3 days, while extensive contamination might require 3-7 days or more, depending on the scope of work.
